relationships.subject: SST2A receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: supporting the receptor’s critical role in altered mechanical nociception caused by AITC-responsive afferent activity in both sexes

key_findings: TRPA1 agonist (AITC)-responsive afferents excite and potentiate spinal dorsal horn SST excitatory interneurons while suppressing a subset of GABAergic interneurons via SST2A receptors (feedback disinhibition).

Intrathecal SST2A-R antagonist CYN 154806 prevented AITC-induced mechanical hypersensitivity and reversed nociplastic mechanical hypersensitivity in both sexes, despite smaller GABAn suppression in males.
